etymology: a primitive root [possibly rather ident. with 06030 through the idea of looking down or browbeating]
avSummary: afflict 50, humble 11, force 5, exercised 2, sing 2, Leannoth 1, troubled 1, weakened 1, misc 11
definition:
1) (Qal) to be occupied, be busied with
 2) to afflict, oppress, humble, be afflicted, be bowed down
    2a) (Qal)
        2a1) to be put down, become low
        2a2) to be depressed, be downcast
        2a3) to be afflicted
        2a4) to stoop
    2b) (Niphal)
        2b1) to humble oneself, bow down
        2b2) to be afflicted, be humbled
    2c) (Piel)
        2c1) to humble, mishandle, afflict
        2c2) to humble, be humiliated
        2c3) to afflict
        2d4) to humble, weaken oneself
    2d) (Pual)
        2d1) to be afflicted
        2d2) to be humbled
    2e) (Hiphil) to afflict
    2f) (Hithpael)
        2f1) to humble oneself
        2f2) to be afflicted
